extracted.name: Buffalo Cauliflower Tacos
extracted.description: These buffalo cauliflower tacos are SO fun and delicious! They're packed with air fryer or oven-baked buffalo cauliflower, crisp veggies, creamy avocado, and tangy vegan ranch. Enjoy them on their own or with a side of black beans, refried beans, or cilantro lime rice.
instruction_lines: Make the buffalo cauliflower and the vegan ranch dressing according to the recipes linked above.
Assemble tacos in the tortillas with the buffalo cauliflower, avocado slices, and cabbage.
Top with jalapeños and cilantro and drizzle with vegan ranch. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing.
